definitions: To quickly return to a normal or sensible state after a period of confusion, daydreaming, or being overwhelmed.
To suddenly become aware of the true situation after being in a state of fantasy or unreality.
examples: The cold water helped him snap back to reality.
After the vacation, it was hard to snap back to reality.
She needed to snap back to reality and focus on her work.
A loud noise made me snap back to reality from my thoughts.
